headlines.title: ETFs Are Net Sellers of Take-Two (TTWO) on Nov. 3
headlines.summary: ETFs sold a net $19.9 million of Take-Two Interactive (TTWO) on Tuesday.

headlines.title: Is Take Two Interactive Software (TTWO) Above Fair Value On Cash Flow?
headlines.summary: Take-Two Interactive Software has given long term holders a strong ride, with earlier gains now sitting alongside a much weaker year for the share price. That puts fresh attention on what the current market value asks of its future cash flows. With the stock recently closing at US$194.99 after a steep year to date decline, investors are increasingly asking whether that tag still lines up with what the business can realistically generate in cash over time.

headlines.title: Why Take Two Stock Is Up 8.9% And What's Next
headlines.summary: Take-Two Interactive Software is back in focus after a Piper Sandler teen survey showed 70% of latest console owners intend to buy Grand Theft Auto VI, with 90% of those planning to play GTA Online, pointing to strong interest in the franchise and its online ecosystem. The same demand signals highlight how crucial GTA Online style recurring spending could be for supporting Take-Two’s bookings targets at a time when analysts expect softer near term earnings and revenue.

headlines.title: Why Piper Sandler Thinks You Should Buy Take-Two Stock Before November 19
headlines.summary: Take-Two shares have plunged 25% in 2026, but Piper Sandler’s bullish GTA 6 survey and massive launch expectations could fuel a major rebound.

headlines.title: Take-Two to Report Q2 Earnings: What's in the Cards for the Stock?
headlines.summary: TTWO's Q2 results face mobile weakness and higher costs, but NBA 2K27 and GTA VI anticipation can support its $8-$8.2 billion fiscal 2027 bookings target.

description: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. develops, publishes, and markets interactive entertainment solutions for consumers worldwide. The company develops and publishes action/adventure products under the Grand Theft Auto, LA Noire, Max Payne, Midnight Club, and Red Dead Redemption names, as well as other franchises. It also publishes various entertainment properties across various platforms and a range of genres, such as shooter, action, role-playing, strategy, sports, and family/casual entertainment under the BioShock, Mafia, Sid Meier's Civilization, XCOM series, Borderlands, and Tiny Tina's Wonderland names. In addition, the company publishes sports simulation titles comprising NBA 2K series, a basketball video game; the WWE 2K professional wrestling series; mobile titles, including WWE SuperCard; and PGA TOUR 2K. Further, it offers free-to-play mobile games, such as CSR Racing, Dragon City, Empires & Puzzles, FarmVille 3, Game of Thrones: Legends, Golf Rival, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells, Hit It Rich!, Match Factory!, Merge Dragons!, Merge Magic!, Monster Legends, NBA 2K, Toon Blast, Top Eleven, Wizard Of Oz Slots Casino, Toy Blast, Words With Friends, and Zynga Poker; and Color Block Jam. The company's products are designed for console gaming systems; and mobiles, such as smartphones, tablets, and personal computers. It provides its products through physical retail, digital download, online platforms, and cloud streaming services. Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. was incorporated in 1993 and is based in New York, New York.
